home.title: Welcome
home.lede: This is the family's reference app: everything a new app starts with, and one small example area to show how the pieces fit.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Write short notes, pin the ones you need, and let the AI suggest a title.

ai.title: AI
ai.body: Set up a local model or connect an online provider. The app's AI features run on what you choose.

help.title: Help
help.body: How the app works, how to set up the AI, and what to do when something goes wrong.

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.message: Your notes are kept by the app's server, in its data folder.

delete.title: Delete this note?
delete.message: “{title}” and everything in it will be deleted. This can't be undone.

form.title: Title
form.pinned: Pin to the top of the list

suggest.hint: Ask the AI for a title from what the note says
suggest.needsBody: Write the note first — the title is suggested from it

settings.title: Settings

general.notesHint: How the Notes list shows your notes.

settings.appearanceHint: How the app looks — applied at once and kept by the app.
settings.backupsHint: A backup holds everything the app keeps: your notes, your settings and your AI setup. Downloaded models aren't in it — they download again.
settings.logsHint: What the server and this window reported, newest last.

storage.locationHint: One folder holds everything the app saves — your notes, the AI engine and downloaded models, and logs. Changing it moves all of that to the new folder and restarts the app.
storage.moving: Moving your data — the app will restart…
storage.desktopOnly: Changing the folder is available in the desktop app.
storage.moveMessage: Everything the app saves — your notes, the AI engine and models, and logs — moves to {folder}. The app restarts when the move finishes.
storage.diskHint: Where the data folder's space goes. Downloaded models and engine logs can be cleared to make room — your notes and settings are never touched.
storage.clearModelsMessage: This frees {size} of downloaded model files. Your models stay in the catalog and download again the next time they're used.
storage.clearModelsShared: This cache is shared with the family's other apps on this computer: clearing it clears their models too.
storage.clearModelsSharedWith: This cache is shared with {apps} on this computer: clearing it clears their models too.
storage.unloadFirst: A model is loaded — unload it first (AI Settings → Unload), then try again.

server.headlessHint: The server hosts the app itself: run {command} and open its address in any browser — no desktop install needed.
server.keepRunning: Keep server running after the app closes
server.keepRunningHint: With this on, closing the window hides the app to the system tray and the server keeps serving — use the tray to show the window again, or to quit for real.
server.tokensHint: Off by default. Add a token to require an {header} header on every {api} call — for when the server is reachable beyond this computer.
server.requireOnLocalhost: Require a token on this computer too
server.noTokens: No tokens — anyone who can reach the server can use it (fine when it's only on this computer).

about.blurb: The family's reference app: the shell, the server, the AI stack, settings, help and tests every family app starts with.
